data: What is the approximate value of the solid orange line at epoch 15 in the left plot?

The question asks for the approximate value of the solid orange line at epoch 15 in the left plot. The left plot corresponds to the In-domain scaffold test setting. The solid orange line represents k = 2. At epoch 15, the solid orange line appears to be around -0.5 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the solid orange line at epoch 15 in the left plot is -0.5.
